decisions: Starlette TestClient buffers entire ASGI responses — cannot stream SSE. SSE tests use uvicorn in a background thread with httpx for real HTTP streaming.
asyncio.Queue.put_nowait() from a background thread needs loop.call_soon_threadsafe() to wake up async waiters. ev._event_loop stored during start_tailer() and used in broadcast().
_SSE_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL and _SSE_POLL_TIMEOUT are module-level constants in server.py, settable by tests via srv._SSE_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL = 0.4 before starting the server.
GET /api/events route added to server.py; uses StreamingResponse with async generator; no new imports beyond json, typing, fastapi.Request.
iter_lines() with httpx splits on newlines — frame collection logic tracks blank lines to detect complete frames (id + event + data + blank line).
caveats: Two websockets DeprecationWarnings from uvicorn/websockets — harmless, from third-party library deprecation, unrelated to our code.
One DeprecationWarning about 'no current event loop' in test_tailer_task_lifecycle — pre-existing from story 01, harmless under Python 3.12.
